scams.name: The Plastic Surgery Clinic Foreigner Price Gouge
scams.avoidance: Research clinics using Korean-language sites (Naver, not just English Google) Join community forums and verify quotes through community members Ask for itemized pricing in writing before any commitment

scams.name: The Taxi Refusal and Overcharge Combo
scams.avoidance: Download Kakao T app before arriving — it has a preset price system with no surprises AREX train from Incheon Airport is much cheaper and faster than any taxi If refused, use public transit — Seoul's subway runs until midnight and is excellent

scams.name: The Fake Buddhist Monk Donation
scams.avoidance: Legitimate monks in Korea do not solicit donations from tourists on the street Hand any item back immediately The Jogye Order officially banned this practice — these are confirmed scammers
scams.location: Insadong, Gyeongbokgung Palace area, busy streets

scams.name: The Itaewon Bar Overcharge
scams.avoidance: Choose your own venues using Naver Maps (Korean equivalent of Google Maps) Set a drink limit mentally before entering any bar Avoid venues with no online reviews entirely

scams.name: The Dental / Medical Tourism Package Bait
scams.avoidance: Verify clinics through community forums and Korean-language review sites, not influencer content Influencer-promoted clinics often pay for promotions, not endorsements based on quality Get itemized written quotes before any procedure
